mapper.select: SELECT p.*, s.subscribe_name FROM payments p INNER JOIN subscribe s ON p.subscribe_id = s.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.create_date DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT s.subscribe_name, p.amount, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(p.start_date, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-%d') start_date, CONCAT( CASE s.billing_cycle WHEN 'MONTHLY' THEN '월' WHEN 'YEARLY' THEN '연' ELSE s.billing_cycle END, ' ', FORMAT(s.price, 0), '원' ) price_info FROM payments p INNER JOIN subscribe s ON p.subscribe_id = s.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = '1' ORDER BY p.start_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments ( subscribe_id, user_id, amount, payment_method, status, create_date ) VALUES ( #{subscribeId}, #{userId}, #{amount}, 'CARD', '1', NOW() )

INSERT INTO user_subscription ( user_id, subscribe_id, billing_key, status, start_date, end_date, next_payment_date ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{subscribeId}, #{billingKey}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE subscribe_id = #{subscribeId}, billing_key = #{billingKey}, status = 'ACTIVE', start_date = NOW(), end_date = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), next_payment_date = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
